accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists_before.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot

hypercore_slot_active_after_action.meaning: HyperCore has the 0x811 supplied-balance slot active after the accepted action
hypercore_slot_active_after_action.checkpoint: after the accepted action, before Accountant backing reads

registered_slot_is_activated_strict_read.meaning: every registered slot is an activated strict-read slot dereferenceable by Accountant backing reads

backing_surplus_accounting_available.meaning: Vault backing/surplus accounting and monitoring are available (reads and settlement succeed)
backing_surplus_accounting_available.checkpoint: while the stale slot remains registered

assumptions: The Accountant is configured on the Vault as stated.
The target BLP slot has no active registration before supplyToBlp is called.
The inactive-slot outcome is treated as the report-supported conditional scenario, not an established prior state.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact timing/ordering of HyperCore activation relative to notifyVaultSupply, so the checkpoint 'after the accepted action' is only loosely bounded.
Report does not define which concrete functions constitute 'backing/surplus accounting and monitoring'; the availability observable is a qualitative Boolean.

limitations: The impact is formalized as unavailability of backing/surplus accounting and monitoring while the stale slot remains registered; the three reverting functions are treated as one outcome.
The inactive-slot precondition is potential/conditional in the report; the plan encodes the report-supported scenario rather than asserting it as certain.
No unauthorized-caller condition is asserted by the report, so none is encoded.
